html: † נֹקֵד n.m. sheep-raiser, -dealer, or -tender (LagNB 108);—abs. נ׳ 2 K 3:4 (of Mesha, king of Moab); pl. אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בַנֹּקְדִים מִתְּקוֹעַ Am 1:1 (of Amos, v. Dr; cf. 7:14, where read נוקד for בוקר according to We Now Dr, not GASm, v. Bu infr.); perhaps gloss, cf. BuKohut-Memorial, 106 f. Nowad loc.
